tools.name: open_in_teleprompter
tools.description: Opens a teleprompter with the script loaded, ready to read while the camera records. In chat apps that show app views it appears right in the chat; it also returns a link to the full teleprompter page. Use it when the user wants to read, rehearse or record a script, speech, pitch or video. Pass the

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "open_in_teleprompter" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "open_in_teleprompter" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
